music.prompt: Tight minimal techno groove at 126 BPM starting instantly on the first beat: a punchy kick on every beat, crisp ticking hi-hats, a pulsing filtered sub bass and small digital blips, building tension with a rising filter toward the end. No melody, no vocals.

Driving melodic techno at 126 BPM that starts immediately at full energy and full volume on the very first beat, with no quiet intro, no build-up and no fade-in: punchy four-on-the-floor kick, rolling bassline, crisp open hi-hats, bright arpeggiated synth stabs and a hypnotic lead motif. Confident and forward-moving, like a modern product launch. Full energy all the way through with no breakdown and no big ending hit. No vocals, no singing.
